title: Araripe green automation heartbeat, version 1
description: When the green deposit lane last tried, and what happened (GREEN_HEARTBEAT_CONTRACT_V1.md). Written at status/green/heartbeat.json by the lane's heartbeat job after every run, success or not, with a compare-and-swap. It deliberately names no release, no window and no count: what is live is the pointer's answer, and a deposit is not a publication.

lane.description: The automation whose attempts this document records. Version 1 has one writer.

latest.description: The most recently finished attempt, whatever its outcome.

last_success.description: The most recently finished successful attempt, carried forward across failures; null until the first success.

stage.description: The job that failed or was cancelled; null for a success.

finished_utc.description: The heartbeat job's clock when it recorded the attempt.

run_id.description: ci-<github.run_id>, as the lane names the run prefix (PHASE_6E §4).
